backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor serving as the backend entry point with no implemented functionality.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented features (color scheme, emoji inputs, heading styles, animations, etc.) to their source files, components, test IDs, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON dictionary providing one-sentence descriptions of each frontend source file, summarizing their styling approach and functionality.
frontend/index.css: Base Tailwind CSS file defining OKLCH CSS custom properties for light and dark theme tokens used by shadcn-ui components.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML shell titled 'Viral Math App' that mounts the React app at the #root div.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app component defining all navigation tabs across three sections (Calculators, Learn, Play) and rendering the corresponding calculator, informational, and game components based on active tab state.
frontend/src/components/CompareReels.tsx: Side-by-side reel comparison tool that accepts engagement inputs for two reels, calculates their engagement rates, and highlights the winner with a neon glow effect.
SVG chart component that plots a view decay curve over time using peak views, decay rate, and days, styled with a purple neon gradient fill and glassmorphism card container.
frontend/src/components/DecaySimulator.t: A React component that simulates view decay over time using exponential decay formula, with form inputs for peak views, decay rate, and days, displaying results via ResultCard and DecayCurveChart.
frontend/src/components/EngagementBarCha: A presentational component that renders a styled horizontal bar chart showing relative engagement breakdown for likes, comments, and shares.
frontend/src/components/EngagementCalcul: A React component that calculates Instagram Reel engagement rate from views, likes, comments, and shares inputs, displaying results with a ViralMeter and EngagementBarChart.
frontend/src/components/FlashcardGame.ts: An interactive flashcard game component with pre-defined cards covering Engagement Rate, Viral Growth, and View Decay topics, supporting shuffle and navigation between cards.
frontend/src/components/GrowthCurveChart: A presentational SVG chart component that plots an exponential viral growth curve based on initial viewers, shares per person, and number of rounds.
A React component that simulates viral growth using an exponential sharing model, accepting initial viewers, shares per person, and rounds as inputs and rendering results with a GrowthCurveChart.
frontend/src/components/HowItWorks.tsx: Renders an educational page explaining three Instagram Reels metrics—Engagement Rate, Viral Growth, and View Decay—with formulas, step-by-step breakdowns, benchmarks, and tips for each.
frontend/src/components/NumberGuesser.ts: Interactive quiz component presenting 10 math-based questions covering Engagement Rate, Viral Growth, and View Decay calculations, with hint/explanation reveal and score tracking.
frontend/src/components/ResultCard.tsx: Reusable display card component that shows a labeled metric value with a gradient color scheme (pink-purple, cyan-green, or purple-pink), glow effects, and an optional unit and emoji.
frontend/src/components/TipsAndTricks.ts: Renders a styled list of Instagram Reels growth tips organized into five categories (Timing, Hooks, Hashtags, Audio, Format), each with tagged actionable advice items.
frontend/src/components/TrueOrFalse.tsx: Interactive true/false quiz component with 12+ statements about Engagement Rate, Viral Growth, and View Decay, tracking user answers and displaying explanations with a score summary.
frontend/src/components/ViralMeter.tsx: SVG semicircle gauge component that visualizes an engagement rate as a needle on a red/yellow/green arc, displaying a zone label indicating low, medium, or high viral potential.
frontend/src/components/WhatWeLearned.ts: Renders a styled 'What We Learned' section with four numbered takeaway cards covering engagement rate, sharing growth, time decay, and algorithm logic, each with neon color theming and gradient accents.
Renders a styled 'Why Reels Go Viral' section with six factor cards (watch time, shares, hook, comments, trending audio, vertical format), each with neon color theming and gradient accents.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor (authenticated or anonymous) using React Query, and invalidates dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and hook, managing AuthClient creation, login/logout flow, identity persistence, and delegation validity checks.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that imports fonts, configures Tailwind with a dark neon oklch color palette, and defines utility classes for gradient text, glassmorphism, and neon glow effects.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the theme with Space Grotesk/DM Sans fonts, oklch-based CSS variable color tokens, neon palette colors, glow box shadows, and custom keyframe animations.
project_state.json: Tracks project metadata, version, architectural notes, and a list of existing features for the Viral Math App — a dark-themed mobile app with three client-side calculators (Engagement, Growth, Decay) targeting Gen Z students.
